preconditions.description: The input contains exactly n+1 lines: the first line with dimensions and n lines for the grid.

preconditions.expression: all(len(line) == m for line in grid_lines)
preconditions.description: Each of the n grid lines has exactly m characters.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'WB' for line in grid_lines for c in line)
preconditions.description: Every character in the grid is either 'W' or 'B'.
Grid dimensions n and m are within the specified bounds.

postconditions.description: The output is the minimum total cost to transform the all-white grid to the target configuration using the four allowed operations.

postconditions.expression: min_cost == sum(c[i][j] * cost[i][j] for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
postconditions.description: The minimum cost is computed by summing the cost of each cell's required flip, where cost[i][j] is the minimum cost to flip cell (i,j) using one of the four corner-based operations, and c[i][j] is 1 if the target cell is black and 0 if white.

postconditions.expression: cost[i][j] == min(1 if i==0 else float('inf'), 2 if i==n-1 else float('inf'), 4 if j==m-1 else float('inf'), 3 if i==n-1 and j==m-1 else float('inf'))
postconditions.description: For each cell (i,j), the cost to flip it is the minimum of the costs of operations that can cover it: operation 1 (cost 1) covers if i=0, operation 2 (cost 2) covers if i=n-1, operation 3 (cost 4) covers if j=m-1, operation 4 (cost 3) covers if i=n-1 and j=m-1.
